title: On seeing Ravana Sugreeva bounces on him
introduction: Rama together with Sugreeva and others mount to the top of Suvela mountain and see the city of Lanka. There, above a gate-way of the City, stands Ravana. Seeing Ravana, Sugreeva springs to the top of the gate where Ravana is bounces on him, pulls his thrown and throws it away on the ground. thereafter, Ravana and Sugreeva carry on duel for a long time without any fatigue. They wrestle endlessly in different postures. Finally, after reducing Ravana to exhaustion, Sugreeva comes back and rejoins his monkey-troops.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे चत्वारिंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 40th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
ततो रामः सुवेलाग्रं योजनद्वयमण्डलम् |
उपारोहत्ससुग्रीवो हरियूथैः समन्वितः
verses.iast:
tato rāmaḥ suvelāgraṃ yojanadvayamaṇḍalam |
upārohatsasugrīvo hariyūthaiḥ samanvitaḥ
verses.translation: Then, Rama along with Sugreeva, together with the troop leaders of monkeys, ascended the top of Suvela mountain which was having a circumference of sixteen miles.

glosses.meaning: having a circumference of sixteen miles (Two yojanas).

verses.devanagari:
स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं तत्रैव दिशो दश विलोकयन् |
त्रिख़ूटशिखरे रम्ये निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा
ददर्श लङ्कां सुन्यस्तां रम्यकाननशोभिताम् |
verses.iast:
sthitvā muhūrtaṃ tatraiva diśo daśa vilokayan |
triKūṭaśikhare ramye nirmitāṃ viśvakarmaṇā
dadarśa laṇ^kāṃ sunyastāṃ ramyakānanaśobhitām |
verses.translation: Halting there just for a while and surveying the ten cardinal points, Rama saw the city of Lanka, which was beautifully constructed by Visvakarma, the divine architect on the top of Trikuta Mountain with nice arrangements and ravishing with enchanting groves.

glosses.meaning: on the top of Trikuta Mountain

verses.devanagari:
तस्यां गोपुरशृङ्गस्थं राक्षसेन्द्रं दुरासदम्
श्वेतचामरपर्यन्तं विजयच्चत्रशोभितम् |
रक्तचन्दनसंलिप्तं रक्ताभरणभूषितम्
वीलजीमूतसंकाशं हेमसंचादिताम्बरम् |
ऐरावतविषाणाग्रैरुत्कृष्टकिणवक्षसम्
शशलोहितरागेण सम्वीतं रक्तवाससा |
संध्यातपेन संचन्नं मेघराशिमिवाम्बरे
verses.iast:
tasyāṃ gopuraśṛṇ^gasthaṃ rākśasendraṃ durāsadam
śvetacāmaraparyantaṃ vijayaccatraśobhitam |
raktacandanasaṃliptaṃ raktābharaṇabhūṣitam
vīlajīmūtasaṅkāśaṃ hemasañcāditāmbaram |
airāvataviṣāṇāgrairutkṛṣṭakiṇavakśasam
śaśalohitarāgeṇa samvītaṃ raktavāsasā |
sandhyātapena sañcannaṃ megharāśimivāmbare
verses.translation: There above a gateway, stood the invincible Ravana the lord of demons, who was being fanned with white whisks on both sides, was graced with a triumphal parasol, was smeared with red sandal paste, adorned with scarlet ornaments, attired in raiment embroidered in gold, resembling a dark cloud, who bore on his breast scars of wounds inflicted on him by Airavata (the elephant who carries Indra the Lord of celestials, on his back) with his tusks, wrapped in a cloak of red colour resembling the colour of hare's blood and looked like a mass of clouds in the sky enveloped with sunshine at sunset.

glosses.meaning: the invincible raakSasendram = the Lord of demons
who was being famed with white whisks on both sides
was graced with a triumphal parasol
was smeared with red sandal paste
as he was attired in raiment embroidered in gold
who bore on his breast scars of wounds
inflicted on his by Airavata (the elephant who carries Indra
in a cloak of red colour
resembling the colour of hare's blood megharaashim iva = looked like a mass of clouds
enveloped with samdhyaa tapena = sunshine at sunset.

verses.devanagari:
पश्यतां वानरेन्द्राणाम् राघवस्यापि पश्यतः |
दर्शनाद्राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सुग्रीवः सहसोत्थितः
verses.iast:
paśyatāṃ vānarendrāṇām rāghavasyāpi paśyataḥ |
darśanādrākśasendrasya sugrīvaḥ sahasotthitaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Ravana, Sugreeva got up all at once, while Rama and the chiefs of the army of monkeys were looking on.

verses.devanagari:
क्रोधवेगेन सं युक्तः सत्त्वेन च बलेन च |
अचलाग्रादथोत्थाय पुप्लुवे गोपुरस्थले
verses.iast:
krodhavegena saṃ yuktaḥ sattvena ca balena ca |
acalāgrādathotthāya pupluve gopurasthale
verses.translation: Gathering up his strength and courage, Sugreeva, in an impulse of fury, bounded from the summit of the mountain and then sprang to the top of the gate (where Ravana was).

glosses.meaning: from the summit of the mountain
to the top of the gate (Where Ravana was).

verses.devanagari:
स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य निर्भयेनान्तरात्मना |
तृणीकृत्य च तद्रक्षः सोऽब्रवीत्परुषं वचः
verses.iast:
sthitvā muhūrtaṃ samprekśya nirbhayenāntarātmanā |
tṛṇīkṛtya ca tadrakśaḥ so'bravītparuṣaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: For a moment, he paused and then with a fearless soul, he saw that demon, whom he regarded as a mere straw and thereafter spoke the following words harshly:

glosses.meaning: whom he regarded as a mere straw

verses.devanagari:
लोकनाथस्य रामस्य सखा दासोऽस्मि राक्षस |
न मया मोक्यसे.द्य त्वं पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य तेजसा
verses.iast:
lokanāthasya rāmasya sakhā dāso'smi rākśasa |
na mayā mokyase.dya tvaṃ pārthivendrasya tejasā
verses.translation: "O, demon! I am a friend and a servant of Rama, the Lord of the world. You will not be spared by me today, by the inspiring grace of Rama."

verses.devanagari:
इत्युक्त्वा सहसोत्पत्य प्लुप्लुवे तस्य चोपरि |
आकृष्य मुकुटं चित्रं पातयामास तद्भुवि
verses.iast:
ityuktvā sahasotpatya plupluve tasya copari |
ākṛṣya mukuṭaṃ citraṃ pātayāmāsa tadbhuvi
verses.translation: Thus speaking, Sugreeva jumped up all at once, bounced over on ravana, pulled his brightly coloured crown from his head and threw it away on the ground.

verses.devanagari:
समीक्स्य तूर्णमायान्तं बभाषे तं निशाचरः |
सुग्रीवस्त्वं परोक्षे मे हीनग्रीवो भविष्यसि
verses.iast:
samīksya tūrṇamāyāntaṃ babhāṣe taṃ niśācaraḥ |
sugrīvastvaṃ parokśe me hīnagrīvo bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: Seeing Sugreeva about to rush upon him again, Ravana spoke as follows: "You were Sugreeva (one who has a handsome neck), when your were not present before my eyes. But now, you will now become Hinagriva bereft of your neck."

glosses.meaning: were Sugreeva (one who has a handsome neck)
when you were not present before my eyes

verses.devanagari:
इत्युक्त्वोत्थाय तं क्षिप्रं बाहुभ्यामाक्षिपत्तले |
कन्दुवत्स समुत्थाय बाहुभ्यामाक्षिपद्धरिः
verses.iast:
ityuktvotthāya taṃ kṣipraṃ bāhubhyāmākśipattale |
kanduvatsa samutthāya bāhubhyāmākśipaddhariḥ
verses.translation: Speaking thus, Ravana raised up and quickly flung Sugreeva to the ground with both his arms. Bouncing like a ball, Sugreeva flung back his adversary with his arms.

verses.devanagari:
परस्परं स्वेदविदिग्धगात्रौ |
परस्परम् शोणितरक्तदेहौ |
परस्परं श्लिष्टनिरुद्धचेष्टौ |
परस्परं शाल्मलिकिंशुकाविव
मुष्टिप्रहारैश्च तलप्रहारै |
ररत्निघातैश्च कराग्रघातैः |
तौ चक्रतुर्युद्धमसह्यरूपं |
महाबलौ राक्षसवानरेन्द्रौ
verses.iast:
parasparaṃ svedavidigdhagātrau |
parasparam śoṇitaraktadehau |
parasparaṃ śliṣṭaniruddhaceṣṭau |
parasparaṃ śālmalikiṃśukāviva
muṣṭiprahāraiśca talaprahārai |
raratnighātaiśca karāgraghātaiḥ |
tau cakraturyuddhamasahyarūpaṃ |
mahābalau rākśasavānarendrau
verses.translation: Ravana and Sugreeva of great strength carried on a duel which was unbearable, with perspiration broke out on their limbs, with their bodies red with blood, each clung to other other paralyzing his opponent's movements resembling silk-cotton and Kimshuka trees, followed by blows of fists, slaps of hands blows of elbows and blows of fingers on each other.

glosses.meaning: with perspiration broke out on the limbs
with their bodies red with blood
resembled the shalmali and Kimshuka trees

verses.devanagari:
कृत्वा नियुद्धं भृशमुग्रवेगौ |
कालं चिरं गोपुरवेदिमध्ये |
उत्क्षिप्य चोत्क्षिप्य विनम्य देहौ |
पादक्रमाद्गोपुरवेदिलग्नौ
verses.iast:
kṛtvā niyuddhaṃ bhṛśamugravegau |
kālaṃ ciraṃ gopuravedimadhye |
utkśipya cotkśipya vinamya dehau |
pādakramādgopuravedilagnau
verses.translation: Having wrestled for a long time in the center of the flat floor of the gate way, each in turn repeatedly lifting their bodies and bending their feet in a particular way, the two highly swift combatants remained in that flat roof of the gate way.

glosses.meaning: in the centre of the flat roof of the gate-way
their feet in a particular way
the two combatants with very high swiftness
remained in that flat roof of the gate-way.

verses.devanagari:
अन्योन्यमापीड्य विलग्नदेहौ |
तौ पेतुतुः पालनिखातमध्ये |
उत्पेततुर्भूमितलम् स्पृशन्तौ |
स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं त्वभिनिःश्वसन्तौ
verses.iast:
anyonyamāpīḍya vilagnadehau |
tau petutuḥ pālanikhātamadhye |
utpetaturbhūmitalam spṛśantau |
sthitvā muhūrtaṃ tvabhiniḥśvasantau
verses.translation: Crushing one another and their bodies clung together, they both dropped down between the defensive walls and the moat. They would leap up again, seizing each other from the ground, after pausing an instant to regain their breath.

glosses.meaning: between the defensive walls and the moat

verses.devanagari:
आलिङ्ग्य चालिङ्ग़्य च बाहुयोक्त्रैः |
संयोजयामासतुराहवे तौ |
सम्रम्भशिक्षाबलसम्प्रयुक्तौ |
सुचेरतुः सम्प्रति युद्धमार्गे
verses.iast:
āliṇ^gya cāliṇ^Gya ca bāhuyoktraiḥ |
saṃyojayāmāsaturāhave tau |
samrambhaśikśābalasamprayuktau |
suceratuḥ samprati yuddhamārge
verses.translation: With arms interlaced like with ropes joined together, they remained locked together in the struggle. Both of them, who had received training in wrestling and fully endowed with night, were now moving to and fro in the arena.

glosses.meaning: with arms interlaced like with ropes
(they) who had received training in wrestling and were fully endowed with night
were now moving to and fro yuddha maarge = in the arena.

verses.devanagari:
शार्दूलसिंहविव जातदंष्ट्रौ |
गजेन्द्रपोताविव संप्रयुक्तौ |
संहत्य संवेद्य च तौ कराभ्यां |
तऊ पेतुतुर्वै युगपद्धरायाम्
verses.iast:
śārdūlasiṃhaviva jātadaṃṣṭrau |
gajendrapotāviva samprayuktau |
saṃhatya saṃvedya ca tau karābhyāṃ |
taU petuturvai yugapaddharāyām
verses.translation: The two heroes, who resembled a tiger and a a lion having their tusks growing or two young lordly elephants encountening in a hostile manner, with arms interlaced and having duly tried their strength, fell on the ground together.

glosses.meaning: who resembled a tiger and a lion
and having duly tired their strength

verses.devanagari:
उद्यम्य चान्योन्यमधिक्षिपन्तौ |
संचक्रमाते बहु युद्धमार्गे |
व्यायामशिक्षाबलसंप्रयुक्तौ |
क्लमं न तौ जग्मतुराशु वीरौ
verses.iast:
udyamya cānyonyamadhikśipantau |
sañcakramāte bahu yuddhamārge |
vyāyāmaśikśābalasamprayuktau |
klamaṃ na tau jagmaturāśu vīrau
verses.translation: Thereafter rising, those two heroes hurled themselves on each other, circling around the arena again and again, like skilled and mighty wrestlers, nor were they easily fatigued.

verses.devanagari:
बाहुत्तमैर्वारणवारणाभै |
र्निवारयन्तौ परवारणाभौ|
चिरेण कालेन भृशं प्रयुद्धौ |
संचेरतुर्मण्डलमार्गमाशु
verses.iast:
bāhuttamairvāraṇavāraṇābhai |
rnivārayantau paravāraṇābhau |
cireṇa kālena bhṛśaṃ prayuddhau |
sañceraturmaṇḍalamārgamāśu
verses.translation: Like unto great tuskers with their enormous arms resembling the trunks, those two warriors were keeping back each other, fought vehemently for a long time and moved speedily in a circular arena.

verses.devanagari:
तौ परस्पर मासाद्य यत्तावन्योन्यसूदने |
मार्जाराविव भक्षार्थेऽवतस्थाते मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.iast:
tau paraspara māsādya yattāvanyonyasūdane |
mārjārāviva bhakśārthe'vatasthāte muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: Approaching each other like tow wild cats fighting over a piece of meat trying to kill each other, they stood growling again and again.

glosses.meaning: fighting over a piece of meat

verses.devanagari:
मण्डलानि विचित्राणि स्थानानि विविधानि च |
गोमूत्रकाणि चित्राणि गतप्रत्यागतानि च
तीर्शीनगतान्येव तथा वक्रगतानि च |
परिमोक्षं प्रहाराणां वर्जनं परिधावनम्
अभिद्रवणमाप्लावमवस्थानं सविग्रहम् |
परावृत्तमपावृत्तमपद्रुतमवप्लुतम्
उपन्यस्तमपन्यस्तं युद्धमार्गविशारदौ |
तौ विचेरतुर्न्योन्यं वानरेन्द्रश्च रावणः
verses.iast:
maṇḍalāni vicitrāṇi sthānāni vividhāni ca |
gomūtrakāṇi citrāṇi gatapratyāgatāni ca
tīrśīnagatānyeva tathā vakragatāni ca |
parimokśaṃ prahārāṇāṃ varjanaṃ paridhāvanam
abhidravaṇamāplāvamavasthānaṃ savigraham |
parāvṛttamapāvṛttamapadrutamavaplutam
upanyastamapanyastaṃ yuddhamārgaviśāradau |
tau viceraturnyonyaṃ vānarendraśca rāvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The two warriors, Sugreeva and Ravana, who were skilled in wrestling, excuted innumerable and myraid evolutions, taking up diverse postures, moving in a curved line like an ox's urine, coming and going, stepping side ways, having a retrograde motion to avoid blows, turning about abandoning the attack, dashing towards each other, leaping, standing firm and erect, retreated, turned sideways, rushed in a bent posture, ran lifting their foot to kick the opponent and by letting go or stealing away.

glosses.meaning: moving in a curved line like an ox's urine
ran lifting their foot to kick the opponent

verses.devanagari:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रक्षो मायाबलमथात्मनः |
आरब्दुमुपसम् पेदे ज्ञात्वा तम् वानराधिपः
उत्पपात तदाकाशं जितकाशी जितक्लमः |
रावणः स्थित एवात्र हरिराजेन वञ्चितः
verses.iast:
etasminnantare rakśo māyābalamathātmanaḥ |
ārabdumupasam pede jJṇātvā tam vānarādhipaḥ
utpapāta tadākāśaṃ jitakāśī jitaklamaḥ |
rāvaṇaḥ sthita evātra harirājena vaJṇcitaḥ
verses.translation: Meanwhile, Ravana decided to common using his magic power. Knowing it, Sugreeva flew into the sky triumphantly shaking off all fatigue, while Ravana, baffled by Sugreeva stood confounded there alone.

verses.devanagari:
अथ हरिवरनाथः प्राप्तसंग्रामकीर्ति |
र्निशिचरपतिमाजौ योजयित्वा श्रमेण |
गगनमतिविशालं लङ्घयित्वार्कसूम |
र्हरिगणबलमध्ये रामपार्श्वं जगाम्
verses.iast:
atha harivaranāthaḥ prāptasaṅgrāmakīrti |
rniśicarapatimājau yojayitvā śrameṇa |
gaganamativiśālaṃ laṇ^ghayitvārkasūma |
rharigaṇabalamadhye rāmapārśvaṃ jagām
verses.translation: Thus, the Lord of the monkeys, acquiring fame as a warrior, reducing Ravana to exhaustion, ascended into the infinite sky and the offspring of the Sun then went to the side of Rama, who as in the middle of the mokye-troops.

glosses.meaning: and that offspring of the Sun
in the middle of the monkey-troops.

verses.devanagari:
स इति सवितृसूनुस्तत्र तत्कर्म कृत्वा |
पवनगतिरनीकं प्राविशत्संप्रहृष्टः |
रघुवरनृपसूनोद्वर्धयन् युद्धहर्षं |
तरुमृगगणमुख्यैः पूज्यमानो हरीन्द्रः
verses.iast:
sa iti savitṛsūnustatra tatkarma kṛtvā |
pavanagatiranīkaṃ prāviśatsamprahṛṣṭaḥ |
raghuvaranṛpasūnodvardhayan yuddhaharṣaṃ |
tarumṛgagaṇamukhyaiḥ pūjyamāno harīndraḥ
verses.translation: That Sugreeva, the offspring of the Sun, who was endowed with a speed of the wind, having accomplished that feat there, increasing the military zeal of the foremost of Raghu dynasty, honoured by the monkey leaders and delighted, rejoined the army.

glosses.meaning: who endowed with a speed of the wind
of the foremost of the Raghu dynasty
